_help: One-time import: adds the Amazon Haul Finds campaign, hidden from the menu. Each product links to the Haul store until you swap in the exact listing (Get Link) in /admin, then tick 'Show in menu'.

campaign.title: Amazon Haul Finds: Keep or Skip?
campaign.intro: Amazon Haul is Amazon's budget store. These are the small, cheap finds worth trying, with an honest keep-or-skip for each. Haul orders usually ship slower than Prime, so order early for gifts.

picks.title: Reusable silicone food storage bags
picks.why: Cuts down on plastic bags for leftovers and freezer meals. Keep if they seal tight with water inside; skip if the zip feels flimsy.

picks.title: Foldable phone stand
picks.why: Hands-free recipes, video calls and TikTok scrolling at your desk. Keep if it holds your phone without tipping.

picks.title: Cable clips and cord organizers
picks.why: Stops chargers sliding behind the nightstand. One of the easiest cheap upgrades for a desk or car.

picks.title: Clear stackable drawer organizers
picks.why: Sorts makeup, junk drawers and bathroom clutter. Measure your drawer first; skip if the plastic is thin and cloudy.

picks.title: Claw clips (multi-pack)
picks.why: A multi-pack means one for the car, the purse and the bathroom. Keep if the teeth close evenly and the spring isn't loose.

picks.title: Touchscreen winter gloves
picks.why: Answer your phone without taking them off. A cheap stocking stuffer; check the fingertips actually work before gifting.

picks.title: Rechargeable motion-sensor closet lights
picks.why: Stick-on lights for closets, stairs and under cabinets, no wiring. Keep if the sensor turns them on every time.

picks.title: Gift bags, bows and tissue paper sets
picks.why: Holiday wrapping for a lot less than the party store. Order now: Haul shipping is slower than Prime.

picks.title: Oil sprayer bottle for cooking
picks.why: Light, even oil for the air fryer and salads. Skip it if it squirts instead of misting.

picks.title: Fuzzy socks (multi-pack)
picks.why: The classic stocking stuffer. A multi-pack covers several people at once; check the sizing in the reviews.
